decisions.reason: Selecting the Business Case site list does not change the candidate's existing capex estimates, site-capex basis, or shared-cost treatment; the separate shared-cost clause already has its own Event.
The authoritative site-list decision does not alter the program-level operating-cost range or its source basis; the Opex clause in the same message is already represented separately.

Choosing the Business Case site list does not necessarily change the availability-payment objectives or sizing targets; those targets are governed by a separate clause already represented in this Requirement.
The site-list selection does not change the debt-equity split, debt cost, mezzanine treatment, or financing structure.
Using the Business Case as the authoritative source for the site list does not replace the broader requirement to annotate assumptions and use the brief and attached materials as primary references.
The site-list decision does not alter the intended government audience, availability-payment narrative, or communication-quality requirements.
Resolving which site list to use supplies a model input but does not change the standing requirements for data review, error checking, or modeling quality.
The authoritative site-list selection does not change the model's presentation-quality or reviewability requirement.
